results.title: Deepika Padukone and Bipasha Basu share a special connection, and it's all about 'Devi'
results.description: Bollywood actors Deepika Padukone and Bipasha Basu have something in common when it comes to their daughters' names. Deepika revealed the name of her second daughter with Ranveer Singh as Devi Padukone Singh on October 20. Bipasha's only daughter, whom she shares with actor Karan Singh Grover, is also named Devi Basu Singh Grover.
